items.stem: A business wants records of one object shared more openly than the org-wide default allows, but only for a specific group. What should an app builder use?

options.rationale: Correct: sharing rules open up access beyond the org-wide default for defined groups or criteria.
Validation rules enforce data quality; they do not control sharing.
Page layouts control UI arrangement, not record access.
Formula fields compute values; they do not grant record access.
